description.value: Valhalla Pure Outfitters (VPO) is a locally operated outdoor gear and apparel chain with 13 stores across BC and Alberta. The New Denver location is the only seasonal store in the chain, operating summers only — making it a notable resource for touring cyclists passing through the remote Slocan Lake corridor of the Kootenays. Each VPO store makes its own buying and staffing decisions, so local outdoor expertise is typically strong.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The New Denver-specific page (https://valhallapure.com/pages/new-denver-bc) returned a 404, but the /contact and /stores subpages confirm the New Denver location at 430 6th Ave with phone (250) 358-7755. The /pages/faq subpage explicitly states 'New Denver is summer operated,' confirming the store is seasonal but real. No bike-specific service content was found anywhere on the website; VPO is an outdoor gear retailer (shop=outdoor in OSM), so all bike amenity fields default to null.
